Usage of `prufyx check` and `prufyx prepare` for this project, as
`--project keda --help` on each route prints it. Identity, stage and rule
coverage: `prufyx catalog cncf --project keda`. Shared flags, exit status and
the reference text of each route: [routes.md](routes.md).

## check cncf

```text
prufyx check cncf --project keda --keda-scaled-object FILE --keda-scaled-object-complete --from 2.16.0 --to 2.17.0 [--keda-legacy-tls-transport-required true|false] (--now RFC3339 | --knowledge-db DIR) [--keda-scaled-object-digest SHA256] [--replay-report FILE] [--format human|json]
```

## prepare cncf

```text
prufyx prepare cncf --project keda --keda-scaled-object FILE --from 2.16.0 --to 2.17.0 --keda-scaled-object-complete [--keda-legacy-tls-transport-required true|false] [--keda-scaled-object-digest SHA256] [--format human|json|input]
```
